1. Colts:

Barring injury, I don't know how you have the #1 WR roster, a top 3-5 QB, a RB that averaged 1k yards per season his entire career and was running for 5yds a carry preseason, 2 upper echelon TE's muck up this offense. If we don't score 3-4 TD's a game, I'm blaming Pep Hamilton because Pep, you have the keys to the city with this lineup. What do you want to do? You can do it, short of trying to run a draw up the middle due to our horrible O-line.

On Defense, we still are a little weak, but consider that last year, when everyone was healthy, our defense held opposing teams to a STUNNING 4-41 on 3rd downs. Less than 10%!!!. Now imagine after all of that, you get Robert Mathis who was the DPOY 2 years ago, it's HOPEfully going to be ugly for the opponents. But they are still weak to the outside run. I'm not sure how they fix it. In a shootout, I'm betting our defense stops the opponents more often than not.

2. Seahawks

I don't know who is more vital to a teams success than Marshawn Lynch. Dude is literally THE BEST RB in the game. Keep your Adrian Peterson and Jamaal Charles. If I could pick one guy to be on my team not named Gore, it would be Lynch. Dude doesn't have a motor, he's got a jet engine in his system. If RB's were trucks, Lynch would be the Ford F650 capable of towing yachts around. They lost last years Superbowl, but they still have Chancellor and Sherman, the best secondary combo in the game. They still have Wilson who is very good at not throwing picks. And they have Jimmy Graham who I expect to get a TON of love from the Seahawks fans after having a great year this year.

3. Packers

To me this might be a bad pick with the loss of Nelson, but the thing is, Aaron Rodgers is the best QB in the league right now. I love my Luck, I do. But Aaron Rodgers hands down has the #1 spot. His ability to play the game is insane and I can't speak highly enough about him. Dude just is that good. I do think they could have issues, but they still have Peppers on defense, still have Cobb and Roddy White is nothing to scoff at. With Lacy running the ball, as long as the rest of the Packers can stay healthy, they have a solid chance at a ring.

4. Patriots

Fuck Tom Brady. But try to fuck him over? You get angry Tom Brady. Dude is going to be pissed and so is Lord Belichick, "Ruler of all that is Dark and Unholy". If Gronk stays healthy, this team is nasty. Brady actually for the first time in his life has a WR who is not only a #1 WR, but who doesn't take plays off. What happened last time Brady had a #1 WR? Oh yeah, he threw for 50 TDs. Mix that with having a guy like Edelman and I see them having a quality year. Unfortunately they lost two major defensive players this year in Browner and Revis. You don't replace them with other guys. You just try to make up for their losses. Angry Brady will help, but I see them losing 1-2 games just because of these losses.

5. Eagles

As much as I don't really care for the Oregon offense in the NFL, it works (for now). This is my dark horse. I could be dead wrong (and probably am) but I think Bradford gets hurt in the first few games of the season. In comes Tebow and suddenly he's back in a college-style offense. Yes it's faster, yes Tebow still is a sucky QB, but I think that this might be the first time he will be in an offense where the coach will tailor it for him. Plus the coach is a racist right and so a white QB that everyone loves to hate is perfect for him right? Right????

6. Broncos

You still have Peyton, you still have D. Thomas and Sanders. I think this is enough with Monte Ball to keep them somewhere in the top 10 and Peyton is looking for one more go. Somehow I see him doing some magic one more year and winning some games they shouldn't.

7. Cowboys

Tony Romo is one of the best regular season QBs in the game. If you just look at his first 3 quarters of every game, he might even be top 5. Dude has some clutch issues from time to time but he seemed to have a good year last year. Might have had something to do with Dez Bryant and DeMarco Murray... too bad you didn't keep Murray. And no, picking up Darren McFadden will not make up for that loss. I think the Cowboys still make a solid showing, but I just never have faith in a team that is constructed by the owner. Jerry Jones may want to win, but he wants attention even more. Just can't trust a man who wants people to look at him all the time.

8. Panthers

Last year was a break-out year. This year I expect 1-2 more wins out of them. Plus they've finished 1st in their division the past two years, I figure this year is another good year for them.

9. Cardinals

Arians is a HELL of a coach. The way the NFC is going, I see the Packers, Seahawks, Panthers and Eagles winning their divisions and the Cardinals and Cowboys fighting for positions.

10. Ravens

Honestly I don't know why I picked the Ravens. I could have said the Dolphins or even the Steelers. But I go with my gut here. Probably should haven't have eaten that burrito, but oh well. I'm full of shit anyways.
